name: OneWorks Avatar
summary: Browser-based 3D avatar editor that exports SVG, PNG and animated GIF, with React, Vue and vanilla JS runtime packages.
description: A 3D geometric avatar editor that runs in the browser: start from a built-in character or build one, adjust pose, position, scale, face, material, lighting, shadow, stroke and animation, then copy SVG or download SVG, PNG or animated GIF at 128–512 px. Versioned avatar definitions render and edit in apps through the @oneworks/avatar packages (React, Vue, web).
contains: exports SVG, PNG and animated GIF at 128, 256 or 512 px
controls for pose, face, material, lighting, shadow, stroke and animation
Agent Skill for creating and integrating avatars
